guide.what_they_sell: AI agents and automated workflows for websites to respond to customers 24/7 and eliminate manual busywork.
guide.audience: Business owners, founders, and team leads dealing with repetitive tasks, manual data entry, and missed after-hours leads.
guide.language: English (with occasional Romanian for local events)
guide.tone: Direct, professional, pragmatic, punchy, and problem-focused
recurring_topics: stop hiring to fix process problems
best_performing_patterns: High engagement on local event coverage (Craiova Hackathon)
Strong engagement on provocative text-heavy hooks addressing business pain points (hiring vs process, manual copy-pasting costs)
hook_examples: Stop hiring to fix a process problem.
Lost a lead while you slept?
Your team is losing 10+ hours a week to copy-paste.
guide.cta_style: Subtle or direct directional links to velosyntech.com and contact emails, or inviting demo requests.
guide.visual_notes: Clean dark or light abstract minimalist background with floating 3D spheres/balloons, bold sans-serif white typography, and clean UI card overlays.
do: Focus on concrete business pains (wasted time, lost money, manual errors)
Use bold, punchy typography on reels and carousels
Highlight specific metrics like hours lost or missed night leads
dont: Bury the hook at the end of the caption
